title: Outward messages
description: Choose the sender for Lark via lark-cli. Automatic sending is off until you approve a scope on a permission card. Other channels and direct CLI writes keep their existing confirmations.
footer: Each automatic attempt records the message, chat, sender and authorization in Sent. A bot must be in the group; failures never switch to your account. Changing the default sender does not broaden existing grants. Revoke grants below at any time.
all_chats: All chats in this channel (not just one group)
pending: Waiting for your permission card. No setting changes before you approve.
saved: Approved setting read back from the server.
failed: Could not verify the setting. Refresh before trying again.
already_delivered: Not sent: send ID delivered earlier
revoke_only: Revocable. This does not recall messages already sent.
